title: Tanzania removes taxes on cement and raw materials to ease prices
summary: Tanzania removes taxes on cement and raw materials to ease prices
body_markdown: **Tanzania:** On 8 November 2026, Prime Minister Mwigulu Nchemba announced the removal of taxes on cement and key raw materials used in its production, including clinker. The measures aim to reduce prices by lowering production and import costs. Nchemba added that cement prices will begin returning to normal levels ‘in the near future.’
